responsibility: This file implements the OpenVMS wrapper for the archiver tool used by GCC builds and driver invocations. It parses GNU ar-style replace/create/extract/verbose command lines, translates Unix file specifications to VMS syntax, applies VMS-specific archive naming such as .olb fallback, writes a temporary DCL command procedure invoking the native LIBRARY utility, and executes it so GCC can manipulate archives through VMS conventions rather than a Unix ar implementation.
